title: Phantasia - Grid Based Crawler Update
author: Epyx911
selftext:
What a time to be alive...month 4 of development where I have begun polishing the game. Just to recap it is a Grid based dungeon crawler based on classics I have enjoyed like "The Bard's Tale", "Alternate Reality the City", "Wizardry", "Etrian Odyssey" and a dash of "Grimrock".

I will be releasing this game hopefully in a few months. and it will include the editor I built for the game (with Claude Code Opus 5.5 of course). The editor allows for full campaign, level creation. There is a portal in the secondary square that will open up the adventure (Module) menu to bring your existing party into newly created adventures and campaigns.

Right now the main base campaign takes about 50 hours to complete.  

I have learned a LOT...particularly when it comes to asset creation with [Meshy.ai](http://Meshy.ai) and chatgpt.  Some of the graphics are Unity bought assets...others were created with the following workflows:

  
3D Models  
  
\-ChatGPT using reference images and a master prompt to maintain consistancy.  -> [Meshy.ai](http://Meshy.ai) to turn the picture into a 3d model. -> Opus 5.5 to bring it into Blender and finetune and animate.

UI  
  
\- ChatGPT images and Photoshop refinement.  Using inspirations and hopefully quality of life features.

Music

\-Suno for Music again using Opus 5.5 to craft each instrumental prompt using a root Master prompt for cohesiveness.

Sprites

\-ChatGPT and Opus 5.5 

Lighting/HDR/Colour Grading/sfx etc

\-All of this I built into my editor so it can be further fine tuned by hand

NEXT STEPS:

\- Continue polishing (by far the most work after making the design document and rules).  Game Testing...have recruited willing friends to game test and using googlesheets to track bugs and fix them. As an IT guy who started his career as an Electronic Arts game testers in the 90s...this is critical and the more eyes the better as you get trenched into certain actions and miss a metric crapton of bugs.

What a time to be alive...to see my dream hybrid CRPG crawler come to life.
